title: Mutating Struct Fields
goal: Use &mut self to alter fields inside a method.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Methods and Traits

sections.text: You use mutable references in functions when you want to modify a value in place.

sections.caption: Score holds a single integer field.

sections.text: To modify struct fields inside a method, the method must take &mut self as its receiver.

sections.caption: &mut self grants exclusive write access.

sections.text: Calling a &mut self method requires the instance variable itself to be declared with let mut.

sections.code:
let mut s = Score { points: 10 };
s.add(5);
sections.caption: The caller binding must be mutable.

sections.text: If the caller variable is immutable, Rust stops the call with error E0596.

explanation: Use &mut self to alter fields inside a method.
